description:
Update a provider

Updates a provider's metadata, such as title, description, or tags. Partial update — pass only the fields to change. Requires active membership. To change the recipe (initialUrl or requests), cut a new version with create_provider_version instead.

body.description: Partial update of an existing provider. Immutable fields (`id`, `orgId`, `slug`) are not accepted here.

region.description: Confirm or override the provider's region. Send `null` to clear it so the provider applies to every region. See `Provider.region`.

seo.description:
Author-set SEO fields. All optional.

Each field is paired with a server-derived default of the
same name on `Provider.seoSuggestions`. Renderers pick the
effective value per field:

    effective.<field> = seo.<field> ?? seoSuggestions.<field>

Set a field here to override; leave it unset to let the
default win. Both objects are returned on every
`GET /providers/{id}` — the builder does not pre-merge.

brandUrl.description: Canonical homepage of the brand (for example, `https://google.com`). Used in brand-link cards and JSON-LD.

dataPoints.description: Full list of data points this provider can verify.

descriptionOverride.description: Replaces the renderer's composed `<meta name="description">` / OG description.

primaryDataPoint.description: Headline data point — the single most-important variable this provider can verify (for example, `subscriber count`). Used in the provider's SEO title.

titleOverride.description: Replaces the renderer's composed `<title>` / OG title. Use when the default composition reads awkwardly.

status.description:
The status of the entity.

- `ACTIVE`: The entity is active.

- `ARCHIVED`: The entity is archived.

items.description: A free-form label attached to an entity for grouping and filtering in listings. Must start and end with an alphanumeric character; only ASCII letters, digits, spaces, and hyphens are allowed between.

visibility.description:
The visibility of the entity.

- `PRIVATE`: Only the owner can see the entity.

- `PUBLIC`: Anyone can see the entity.

If-Match.description:
Opaque `ETag` from a prior GET on the same resource. When
supplied, the server applies optimistic concurrency: the
mutation fails with `412 Precondition Failed` if the
resource has been modified since. Omit for last-write-wins.

name: update_provider
